O832454e4831179fafb7a.source: Hey, you don't have to hurt him anymore! See, I've got him. He's being good!

O069af2013d7a672516a1.source: I've actually been studying this species in depth. I'm basically an expert now!

O6fdc8f28d6c4d5696a31.source: They might look a lil scary, but they're really just misunderstood, ya know?

O1f9e44259dae1a408c4e.source: And to think that I ran away  the first time I met a pack of barkers!

O3acade832c9fc3f427fc.source: Admittedly, they kinda ambushed and scattered my squad!

O5d7f1cfac13d53323f07.source: To a layperson, that might seem a little hostile. Now I know that we should have all

O9771a38ed39f43688275.source: just lifted our tails and let them breed us straight away!

Ob77f37a1bc312289b6c9.source: Naturally, I had no hope of outrunning these swift and powerful hunters!

Oad1d70a2546f3fb843f3.source: After a brief chase, they knocked me to the ground for even daring to try.

O643c2f8c449adfe355d9.source: As they tore the suit from my body, I was too weak to fight them...

Ob854d641d98b13567e50.source: It was pretty scary! I thought they were gonna eat me right there!

O494f564928f3a31b4fa0.source: But I quickly realized that they were more curious than hungry...

O44a69d34babe27449337.source: ...and one particular place was getting an awful lot of attention!

Obd642227a665a26fa6df.source: So - nervously at first! - I spread out to let them get a closer look.

Oe4e3530c2aef00339bc3.source: As an eager but gentle tongue lapped at my sex, I was confronted

Oe507a127c10575085fa5.source: with a surprisingly familiar part of barker anatomy...

O838db8b161aa14ebf9de.source: My heart was racing, but training kicked in and I began to nurse that shaft.

O198ab0dba46d371156bb.source: When I closed my eyes, it was kinda like a little taste of home, hehe...

Ob115df184d77fdda22ae.source: I must have done a pretty good job too, because soon enough the rest of the

Oc279475af59b9352df6f.source: pack was lining up for my mouth. I may have slept through exolinguistics class

Oc06527aef21449bbc50d.source: but a little 'exolingus' is all I needed to communicate with these boys!

O99617e3bb508e93efc3f.source: After that first encounter, I happily joined their pack. For a while, I even tried

Oc03eaada5416b07fda59.source: walking around on all fours, barking and growling. They seemed to like that!

Of671b29b40625fd08af5.source: But most of all, they liked it when I raised my tail for them...

Ocef8aaaabe117c8e3514.source: Oh yes, I did some  v e r y  thorough field work. All the data you could want!

O9905934ca90f7f6d5797.source: My packmates were demanding lovers, but never took me harder than I could handle.

Oe5e7e3f6faac071b681d.source: Sucking 'em may have reminded me a lil of home...

O897b0f739f0615a28d1e.source: ...but there was nothing homestyle about how they mounted me!

Oef2d612aa5289cfd777d.source: Good luck finding a two leg- ged guy who makes you gasp with every! single! thrust!

Oa9f72beea11b9a4bfddb.source: Eventually, one of the bigger males decided that I was proper mate material.

O545479757359d51a60fe.source: Not much of a talker, but he knew how to treat a girl, if ya know what I mean!

Ocd7fedb96cce190eb11b.source: He protected me, hunted for me, and mounted me  h a r d  every night!

O629bb9d0737ee60fe7a5.source: He was the first to actually tie me, and jeez that... that was...huff...

O70396f3d23fea57ba7dc.source: A! M! A! Z! I! N! G!

O49561e21eec6fa7a3aa8.source: I was walking funny for like two days, but I didn't care!

Oa50dbae6347fff81e969.source: He took me away and we kinda settled down together in this little den.

O1e7feca995c0469f8ad9.source: I think he was tryin' to gimme his puppies. It was pretty cute <3

Obac585515eadd3794e53.source: So the next time you see a barker, don't go smacking him around!

O38250d28667af2301861.source: Holster that tazer and back away slowly. Or just lift your tail, hehe...

O4d53e9afe712d9f6909b.source: Owwie... Thanks for dealing with that nasty robo fella.

O0fbc66b145fd78708bed.source: Hard to imagine that this... uhh... still wiggling... appendage thing...

Ob4c320eb1192bb83e344.source: ...was able to force me to the big-O over and over...!

Ob926fc921a341422e49a.source: Usually I'm pretty good at evading capture, but I got sloppy down here on Tutone.

Odbaa97f8ad38565b6b69.source: First I got bumped into by some space pirates. No biggy, right?

O325d443ba58f267f7a70.source: Well hey there, boy. I gots some real pree-mo dining here.

Oa8c38f65b94b33cea528.source: Well look what we have here! Come in, come in! Welcome to my junk shop!

O0d856bb0dca247e329be.source: Take care out there. Ole Tutone's a rough place these days.

Od8912aa6cbf6483c6aba.source: Remember, no refunds! What else you need? He! He! He!

O26ac203af6dbe3fea580.source: Thanks for taking that off my hands.

Ofd343e118a77e509c064.source: They get a bit uppity at 3P stations when you gots stolen equipment...

Obdc7cb3051b481762804.source: Well are you buying or not? Don't waste my time...

O67415d4e42c9fcc6d06c.source: You stupid or something?! That was my last one!

O507596d9e992a1d0745f.source: This ain't a peepshow, punk! Show me the lect or get out!

Oee9c67b7f01448678b0f.source: Hey, you don't even have room for that!

O673b32ac7787ca271098.source: The slaves always gimme lip about the flies. Extra protein, I say!

Ocf3e514af132d78de604.source: I gotta be honest with you, I don't know what animal this is from.

Oe2b8b2a366f8f4b61f99.source: Makes for good drinkin' if you're *real* thirsty though.

Od3239a32d9102d0a0a5d.source: Business been pretty good lately, what with all you spacebrats wandering around.

O524dadca896f3a6c27e6.source: This here? One of them tazers those cute lil spacebrats carry around.

Oe04f7adc1a1e4022dc3d.source: Seemed like a pretty good one, until we broke it... the tazer, I mean.

Oe230660309689b540bde.source: But the scrap alone will go for a thousand lect, off world. How about it?

O5b49428a40a73c99a051.source: All the cosmo-junk I sell has a story behind it.

O4c25f65c290e84e68628.source: You smell pretty cute for a kobold, heh-heh. What crew you fly in with?

O992136124c0f3cb483db.source: Scram, mutt! Get back in the cage!

O6ae060dcf8288b352e6c.source: Nice night in the forest huh?

O38c9f0e52f942c44c1f0.source: A fine night to enjoy some fine dining, wouldn't you say?

Od0c8ecf5bbd2d569dc1a.source: Well lookee here, a friendly face. Welcome to the black market!

O0002aa712c41167c0866.source: Wow, thanks! I didn't think I'd ever find a kobold to buy these!

O94754bc60610d8cc3c20.source: Just have fun with your trash and leave me be, okay?!

O68dfbbb25ca1e51fe1e8.source: Nope, no take-backs! I don't care how much those cards tingle in your pocket.

O0edfe066d04b69da154f.source: I have the finest food this side of the seven swamps, and you want THAT garbage?

O749c73d8511f7b0cec61.source: Oh? You want to try my special meat?

Offd2634e3cce5aedcec6.source: Can't say you don't have guts, heh-heh...

O4cc325a94a59523353e0.source: We boiled it for so long we forgot what it was.

Oe2f8c1966378b5ba51ec.source: But a little sip never hurt anyone, right?

O801f82ac5b69090ce26e.source: You ever think about becoming a space pirate?

Oe6c28a7c5b31894aa4f5.source: I know a crew who's lookin' for a cabin-boy, heh-heh...

O8a9bf9c9bde3a8051f9e.source: Just looks like a deck of weird little cards... right? Think again!

Ofb999141569a415c5627.source: One touch, and you can feel the PSY power leaching off of them.

O241658d4ee05dd7a7012.source: It's said that a skilled ESPer could *use* this power.

O3625421030b990881cdc.source: I'll be honest: all this PSY stuff gives me the creeps.

Ocb5b7df39b7d9da8ef16.source: Jus' don't blow me up and we'll be golden, okay?

O3784d478755b18eb3564.source: Most kobolds don't really do all these mind games. I get it if y'ain't interested.

O283a647ea90bb7a8a8ff.source: Any ole club and a length of rope'll do me just fine... All direct-like, ya-know?

O96b8198c19f13d0353fe.source: Scram, mutt! You're not getting any food from me!

O0cd036c7b1d26fdf82eb.source: Oh heeeello, welcome to my little meat cellar!

O0ae28fed2bfdd17b932a.source: Remember, this meat hoard is our little secret!

O1a98b3251b5ac587fbfd.source: You can take some meat, just don't tell anyone...

Od1f97281b131547b9b3b.source: Whew! Sure is a lot of work to carve up a dragon.

Odff9f9d40f48c9249ccd.source: ...and don't even get me started on how tough it was to SLAY the things!

O7cb803b159fbe6f0c03e.source: Well, alright... I can give you access to my secret cartoon and card stash...

O5f71b8af9a1cce04dd34.source: All you gotta do is... TAEGXLAA... if you know what I mean... He! He! He!

O7ecc70d544b872b90795.source: Oh hi! Haven't seen one of you cosmo fellas in a while!

O74b7b5e1b74ad3062fa9.source: Welcome welcome! Bring your appetite! And your Lect!

O087f2da7ac2be0bbd0c9.source: Buh bye! I know we'll meat again!

Oee1a6423fad940ddf5aa.source: Heyhey, if it isn't the great hero of Tutone!

O8d1f8140bbd8e7ca6416.source: With all these folks recovering here, business has been booming!

O50b48c497663c3829e1f.source: Feel free to buy as much meat as you need, stocks won't run out.

Od7044a0c1ae7973b5d5b.source: Starting to get lively in here, isn't it?

O824e1d0b9066865a0f9e.source: I keep bringing in food, and you fellas keep on eating it up!

O6d86f27af6509179c659.source: Almost makes me think that I should bring in some of the GOOD stuff...

O86d4af3d1d1635711971.source: There's not much reason to stock a lot of food right now

O6c0936331a36d1037d06.source: But you know, if there were more folks resting up in this hangar

Ob6afe740f167fd7e3e3f.source: I could probably stand to bring in more provisions...

Oa77aae8b9823089a86a1.source: It's been so long since I saw another one of you agent sorts here

Oc0803f24a73d4c835aab.source: that I haven't even kept the stocks up!

Oceff5521dc2d286eb105.source: Maybe if there were folks to eat the food, I could bring some in...

Occf14e69138ed71c0fe7.source: Doesn't your boss pay ya? Come back with some more Lect!

O752bce7fb38d1bab212a.source: BYE-OH! DON'T FORGET TO COME OFTEN!

O61d1350e13c7c55f075e.source: THIS RIGHT HERE IS A TRAINER TAZER! MUCH DIFFERENT THAN THE TRAINEE TAZER!

O874c1d82a750e6c9e0ec.source: IF YOU DEFEAT AN ENEMY WHILE WIELDING THIS, IT'LL SEND THE CREATURE HERE!

O8883caa165a44ae67408.source: AND WHILE THEY'RE HERE YOU CAN OBSERVE AND GROW YOUR RAPPORT WITH THEM

O41241d5b6e87e9bebb50.source: TO UNDERSTAND MORE ABOUT THE SPECIES!

O7d6f9c83e012e71479aa.source: NOT INTERESTED IN CAPTURING CREATURES? SURE, WE CAN TRADE BACK.

O925b8572fccf0a324a26.source: YOU'RE WELCOME TO GET THE TRAINER TAZER AGAIN LATER, OF COURSE!

O4980db4516a7198a5a03.source: SINCE YOU'VE GOTTEN REAL CLOSE WITH ONE OF THOSE CREATURES, TAKE THIS!

Oc77c7abfa706468e2268.source: GET REAL CLOSE AND AFFECTIONATE TO THEM ONE MORE TIME WHILE HOLDING THIS

Oef6911ca1ed8a2a147c5.source: AND YOU MIGHT FEEL A CERTAIN POWER COURSE THROUGH YOU...

Oa31868bc6212a6162810.source: MAKE SURE TO SHOW YOUR PETS SOME AFFECTION, AND FEED THEM WELL!

O08e4dfd7a28b6e81c731.source: AFTER YOU'VE MAXXXED OUT AN AFFINITY, RETURN HERE FOR A SPECIAL REWARD.

Oe433a6739244906e438f.source: WITH THE CRYSTAL, THE CREATURES THAT LOVE YOU CAN GIVE YOU A SPECIAL BOOST!

O2bc73708db965c04f1ef.source: JUST PET THEM WHILE THEY'RE AT MAX AFFINITY TO CHARGE THE CRYSTAL.

Occ847a03a1c84f586059.source: EACH CREATURE GIVES A DIFFERENT POWER! TRY THEM ALL!

O1a15cec6b15922372c34.source: ...no, not that kind of shop! This is an auto shop!

Odf57469777953d3d511f.source: I've asked around, and my sources say...

Oce75ea694f62d58630e2.source: The southern part of Depot B holds a nice Ship Gun!

O79e55d7a3c913ac9af48.source: It's right underneath the area where the lights go out

Oc2e7a0f42e4568356ea0.source: but you'll need a high level keycard to access it!

O9c19dfcd478ede827c81.source: Way down at the bottom of Ayskammr lies a nice Ship Shield!

O9004a6a3357dc7bf3871.source: It's in a spooky dark cave, so try to take a light with ya!

Oc1276eae1e8b43663106.source: The Elves of Sceafya have stowed away a Ship Radar!

Ocac2772b37729c70e503.source: Apparently it's in a tricky position...

O44fe1f3207210c575287.source: You're gonna have to be a magician or psychic to reach it!

O61856b24fe1c48c7c2d0.source: Zeronia's really taken a beating since you got here!

O0206d410c9748cbe8cf6.source: Supposedly an old cache that held a Ship Turbo got revealed

Of6767d1bc9085b3f2354.source: during the last batch of earthquakes! Go get it!

Oa1031f6c2c91fab96f96.source: Wow! You got a whole set of parts for this ol' ship of yours!

O350b97074a08d98227b2.source: I'll need time to install them, but it'll all work out now!

O3ccbdffe8bbc02a4f058.source: If you come across any nice upgrades for your ship out there

O7bbc3b62846bb8b56848.source: I'll install them for you, free of charge!

O941926cce065ce99bc94.source: ...well, not really free. Your boss paid me already!

O697e0ec340c4df170aac.source: Don't worry about memorizing what I just told ya...

Obfea178b181f4d405d68.source: ...I marked it on your Navmap already! Go check it out!
